model_annotation: The diagram compares the distribution of enterprises, employment, and net turnover across four industries: industry, construction, trade, and other services in 2021, and it consists of three donut charts representing the number of enterprises, number of persons employed, and turnover. The charts are divided into four sectors, each representing one of the industries, and color-coded according to a legend at the bottom. The number of enterprises chart has "other services" as the largest sector, represented in blue, accounting for 61% or 19.0 million, followed by "trade" in red at 19% or 5.9 million, "industry" in yellow at 12% or 3.7 million, and "construction" in dark blue at 8% or 2.4 million. The number of persons employed chart also has four sectors, with "other services" at 51% or 80.2 million, "trade" at 21% or 33.0 million, "industry" at 19% or 29.5 million, and "construction" at 9% or 13.4 million. The turnover chart has "other services" at 33% or 10.6 trillion, "industry" at 33% or 9.9 trillion, "trade" at 31% or 9.8 trillion, and "construction" at 6% or 1.9 trillion. All three charts include a legend that explains the color coding for each industry, and the percentages and absolute values are displayed within each sector.
